provenance.asset_description: Two individual pieces of art overlayed over a blurred background. The left image is a battered and beaten Hesla Embersplitter, a pale skinned redheaded woman, looking straight on at the viewer, her her hair in disarray and her clothing a mess, but her stare still adamant. Above her head is the Pathfinder Society text logo. The image on the right is an alien magitech robot surveys its surroundings with a single glowing eye sensor. Its humanoid torso is perched atop a rotating spherical lower body. One of its arms ends in a sharp clamp and the other in a sleek rifle. Under the robot is the Starfinder Society text logo.
